capabilities: Convert a Markdown note into a floor/reply thread via frontmatter marker
Add, edit, delete, sort, and favorite floors and replies
Browse favorite floors in a sidebar and jump to the source record
Render record bodies as Markdown with image resizing and descriptions
Switch among Bubble, Glass, Paper, and Timeline layouts and bundled color palettes
extras: Malformed thread files intentionally fall back to native Markdown with a diagnostic instead of a destructive render; the README warns the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff and documents BRAT and manual installation for unlisted releases.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to view or manage a note as a threaded discussion where each entry and its replies stay as plain Markdown.
summary: Threaded-note plugin that renders a Markdown file as a forum-style record of floors and replies with editing, favorites, and four layouts.
